title: Lawrenceburg: from Kaufman's Station to Anderson County seat

bodyMarkdown:
German immigrant Jacob Kaufman settled the site in the early 1780s as Kaufman's (Coffman's) Station. A post office opened in 1817 for tavern-keeper William Lawrence; Franklin County incorporated the town as Lawrence in 1820. When Anderson County was cut from Franklin, Mercer, and Washington in 1827, the place was renamed Lawrenceburg and made the county seat.
Source: [Lawrenceburg, Kentucky (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lawrenceburg,_Kentucky)
